targets.why: Animals or objects mistaken for people become false alarms
Unauthorised vehicles are a core threat (PS item 3)
Census and conflict alerts need animals found (PS item 1)
When we commit to a species name it should usually be right; uncertain ones stay unverified
Species identified where data allows (PS item 2)
Small people seen from drones (PS item 5)
Night and aerial improvements must not cost daytime recall

system_targets.check: Sustained processing of at least 5 frames per second per stream on a team laptop
Frame lag stays under 1 second when inference is slower than the camera
IDF1 of at least 0.60 on demo/clips/night_thermal_people.mp4 against its ground-truth tracks
At least 80% fewer alerts than per-frame alerting on the night clip, while every person track still raises an alert (abstract)
Under 5 seconds from first sighting in a frame to the alert arriving on Telegram (abstract)
